summary.headline: Unconnected and Sympathetic Signs
summary.text: Chapter 16 classifies unconnected zodiacal signs and signs sympathetic through equal ascension, equal power, or shared zone, giving examples such as Aries with Pisces and Gemini with Capricorn. It relates these configurations to co-ascensions, stellar co-risings, and sympathies among people, including men and women, parents, siblings, friends, and slaves.
